feeds.title: Supconnect.com
feeds.description: Supconnect is your connection to the stand-up paddle community. A leading SUP Magazine and Social Network, with tips, events, news, photos, videos, and more.

feeds.title: SipaBoards
feeds.description: SipaBoards are self-inflating SUPs with a fully-integrated, emission-free jet engine for that little push you need to help keep you paddling. We are here to include more people and open up a fun, popular, low-impact sport to an even broader audience. The ultimate goal of SipaBoards is to stick together: with our children, our parents, grandparents, beginners, or anyone else who needs a little help paddling back.

feeds.title: Paddle Monster
feeds.description: Paddle Monster is a paddling community created by co-founders Larry Cain and John Beausang in 2016. It began as a paddle training platform, providing subscription-based coaching to paddle athletes around the world. Paddle Monster will elevate training for everyday paddlers who want to achieve specific goals. We will give normal paddlers access to the best training and technique information available.

feeds.title: Stand Up Paddle Boarding Guide
feeds.description: Stand Up Paddle Boarding Guide brings to you gear reviews, instructional video, statistics, and more. Startup, maintain and explore the world of stand up paddle boarding - all you need to know.

feeds.title: Paddle Board Nation
feeds.description: Paddle Board Nation is a paddle boarding blog that helps you find the best paddleboards, gear, and learn about all things paddleboarding.

feeds.title: PaddleAwayToday Blog
feeds.description: PaddleAway.today is a certified SUP school that wants to make paddleboarding accessible to all ages. SUP is fun! Being on the water and able to go anywhere you want with just a paddle, is exciting and provides a strong sense of freedom. Ride the lake-waves or just glide. Subscribe to get updates from the blog.

feeds.title: THURSO SURF
feeds.description: Thurso Surf was founded to jolt people out of their everyday routines and encourage them to seek their true selves. Thurso Surf blog is all you need to know about SUP. Find SUP Knowledges, How-tos, Techniques, and Tips. Subscribe to our bi-weekly newsletter to stay tuned.

feeds.title: StandUpPaddleBoardsReview
feeds.description: Paddleboarding is one of the fastest-growing sports in the world, but for beginners, it is not always easy to get started. Hi, I am David De Haan and I am the owner of this website. I love being on and near the water. Even as a kid I was always fishing, boating, building rafts, and a bit later, kayaking, windsurfing, or sailing. I help you find the best paddleboard for you and your family. SUP board & gear reviews, paddleboard tips and advice.

feeds.title: ISLE Blog
feeds.description: Paddleboard and surf blog from Isle Surf and SUP. We offer expert advice on all things paddle boarding and surfing. Stay Better In Balance with ISLE. Find the best stand up paddleboards, SUP paddles, accessories and surfboards online. Read our blog today to learn more!

feeds.title: Blue Planet Hawaii
feeds.description: Blue Planet is known as Hawaii's SUP Headquarters with the biggest selection of boards, paddles and accessories you will find anywhere. We offer new and used boards, rentals, foils, surfboards, Stand Up Paddleboards and surf accessories. Get updates about the Blue Planet brand, dealers, team riders, and ambassadors.

feeds.title: Sun n' Sup Blog
feeds.description: Sun n' Sup is the only full-service Paddleboard Shop in the South Okanagan. The shop provides all things SUP from boards to ankle leashes, PFD's and a great selection of summer clothing.
